tips.title: No more than two people
tips.text: We recommend smoking one hookah for no more than two people. This is due to temperature regimes as well as individual taste preferences and the intensity of smoking.

tips.title: Flavor for your individual request
tips.text: We can offer you both ready-made combinations and select a flavor for your individual request (for example, fruity, berry, citrus, tropical, dessert, nutty, lemonade, alcoholic, coffee, floral, herbal, tea).

tips.title: Ask the shisha master
tips.text: We have a wide assortment of hookahs, hookah bowls, as well as brands and flavors of hookah tobacco. You can ask the shisha master to tell you about the assortment and the differences in smoking.

tips.title: Strength levels
tips.text: We can make your hookah of varying strength levels. If you don't know what strength level you need, the hookah master will help you decide.
